proof.text: Construct iteratePairing by recursion, beginning with identity. Prove the insertion law by induction on n and Fin.cases. The base case is the unit law and T(id)=id. Index zero uses the unit law and unit naturality; successor uses naturality of b, T composition, and the induction hypothesis. Godement map identity, composition and unit naturality are proved locally from the product projections and stalk-skyscraper adjunction, following the already-proved private arguments in ModuleCupGodementRelations.

theorem moduleCup_godement_iterate_pairings_from_beta (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F G : X.Modules) (b : ∀ H K : X.Modules,
      moduleCup_godementObject X H ⊗ moduleCup_godementObject X K ⟶
        moduleCup_godementObject X (H ⊗ K))
    (hnat : ∀ (H K H' K' : X.Modules) (f : H ⟶ H') (g : K ⟶ K'),
      (moduleCup_godementMap X f ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementMap X g) ≫ b H' K' =
        b H K ≫ moduleCup_godementMap X (f ⊗ₘ g))
    (hunit : ∀ H K : X.Modules,
      (moduleCup_godementUnit X H ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementUnit X K) ≫ b H K =
        moduleCup_godementUnit X (H ⊗ K)) :
    ∃ (p : ∀ n : ℕ, moduleCup_godementIterate X F n ⊗
        moduleCup_godementIterate X G n ⟶ moduleCup_godementIterate X (F ⊗ G) n),
      p 0 = 𝟙 (F ⊗ G) ∧
      (∀ n, p (n + 1) = b (moduleCup_godementIterate X F n)
        (moduleCup_godementIterate X G n) ≫ moduleCup_godementMap X (p n)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        (moduleCup_godementInsert X F n i ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementInsert X G n i) ≫
          p (n + 1) = p n ≫ moduleCup_godementInsert X (F ⊗ G) n i)

title: Recursive pairings from compatible beta
statement: For every scheme X and module sheaves F,G, let T, eta and u be the Godement object, unit and insertion maps of [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model]. Given maps b(H,K): TH tensor TK → T(H tensor K) natural in both variables and satisfying (eta_H tensor eta_K); b(H,K) = eta_(H tensor K), there are p_n: T^n F tensor T^n G → T^n(F tensor G), with p_0 = id, p_(n+1) = b(T^n F,T^n G); T(p_n), and (u_(n,i)^F tensor u_(n,i)^G); p_(n+1) = p_n; u_(n,i)^(F tensor G) for all n and i in Fin(n+1).
